name: arch-single.png
prompt: Redesign image 1, a Korean backend blog architecture diagram. Image 2 is STYLE reference only: use generous white space, large official-looking recognizable technology logos floating on white, thin black directional arrows, sparse orange runtime boundary, clean Korean typography. Landscape 1536x1024 or similar. Title '단일 인스턴스 구조', subtitle 'EC2 t2.micro · 앱과 DB가 같은 자원을 공유'. Outside orange thin boundary on left Apache JMeter feather logo labeled 'JMeter' and '부하 발생'. Arrow HTTP to Spring Boot green leaf logo inside boundary labeled 'Spring Boot'; below small text 'Caffeine 로컬 캐시' and 'HikariCP'. Arrow JDBC labeled '읽기 · 쓰기' from Spring Boot to MySQL dolphin logo labeled 'MySQL'. Boundary labeled 'AWS EC2 t2.micro' with AWS EC2 icon and small 'Docker'. App and MySQL BOTH entirely inside SAME EC2 boundary. Bottom note '앱과 DB가 같은 인스턴스의 CPU와 메모리를 공유한다.' Remove original test-specific VUser, dataset counts and pool counts since reused across different experiments. Only these nodes. No deployment pipeline, Redis, replica, Nginx, monitoring, performance claims. Professional portfolio architecture like reference, not cards or dashboard. Keep arrows unambiguous.

name: arch-scaleout.png
prompt: Redesign image 1, Korean backend blog architecture diagram. Image 2 is STYLE only: white page, floating recognizable technology logos, thin black arrows and sparse orange runtime outline; spacious professional portfolio architecture, no card/dashboard aesthetics. Wide 1536x1024. Title '수평 확장 구조', subtitle '로컬 Docker 부하테스트 · HAProxy + App 2대'. JMeter at left outside orange boundary 'Docker 테스트 환경'. Inside boundary HAProxy logo then fork arrows to two vertically stacked Spring Boot leaf logos 'App-1' and 'App-2'. Both apps arrows converge into ONE MySQL logo on right 'MySQL Primary', '읽기 · 쓰기'. Label JMeter->HAProxy 'HTTP'. HAProxy caption '첫 요청: round-robin' and '이후: SERVERID 쿠키로 고정'. Under each app '2 CPU · 2 GiB' and '로컬 세션 · Caffeine'. Under database '1 CPU · 1 GiB'. Bottom two clean short notes: '앱별 세션과 캐시는 독립적이다.' and 'Redis · Read Replica 미사용'. Preserve exactly JMeter->HAProxy->both apps->single database topology. No EC2/cloud, no claims CPU saturated, no performance claims, no second database. Large logos and easy reading like reference.

name: arch-replica.png
prompt: Redesign image 1 Korean backend blog architecture; image 2 style reference only. White background, floating recognizable logos, thin black arrows, orange sparse boundary, generous whitespace. Landscape wide. Title '읽기 분리 구조', subtitle '로컬 Docker 부하테스트 · MySQL Primary / Replica'. JMeter left -> HAProxy -> TWO Spring Boot apps App-1 upper and App-2 lower inside orange 'Docker 테스트 환경'. Put small routing hub to right of both apps labeled 'DataSource 라우팅'. BOTH app outgoing arrows reach this hub. Hub splits to MySQL Primary upper right and MySQL Replica lower right. Route hub->Primary labeled '쓰기 · 일관성이 필요한 읽기', hub->Replica labeled 'readOnly 읽기'. Clearly separate vertically downward dashed arrow FROM Primary TO Replica labeled '비동기 복제 · GTID'. Under HAProxy 'SERVERID 세션 고정'. Under apps 'Spring Boot · Caffeine'. Bottom notes 'Sticky Primary 활성화 시, 쓰기 직후 읽기는 Primary로 보낸다.' and '커넥션 풀 · 부하량 · Sticky 설정은 실험별 본문 참조'. Remove obsolete specific pool sizes, VUser counts, workers, 90% read claim. Do NOT call Primary write-only. Do NOT claim exact consistency guarantees or zero replication lag. No Redis no EC2 no monitoring no deployment pipeline. Crisp Korean text, legible arrows with enough separation.

name: arch-redis-target.png
prompt: Redesign and factually correct image 1 Korean architecture image. Image 2 STYLE reference only: white page, floating recognizable logos, thin black arrows, minimal orange grouping outline, generous whitespace professional architecture. Landscape 1536x1024. Title 'Redis 도입 후 목표 구조', subtitle '설계안 · 이 글 작성 시점에는 미구현'. Left HAProxy -> two vertically stacked Spring Boot logos App-1 App-2, caption under HAProxy 'round-robin · 세션 고정 제거'. Under EACH app 'Caffeine L1 · 로컬 simple broker' and 'WebSocket 연결·구독 유지'. To right single prominent Redis red logo inside thin orange outline '공유 저장소 · 이벤트 전파'. Both apps have bidirectional arrows to Redis area. Inside Redis area three neatly spaced concise capabilities with no individual boxes: 'Spring Session — 세션 저장', 'Pub/Sub — 캐시 무효화 전파', 'Pub/Sub — 브로드캐스트 이벤트 전파'. Under apps lower row a small shared node 'DB 라우팅' connected FROM BOTH apps, split arrows to MySQL Primary ('쓰기') and MySQL Replica ('읽기'), and dashed Primary->Replica replication arrow label 'GTID'. Essential correction original STOMP broker relay under Redis IS WRONG: never write STOMP relay; local simple brokers and subscriptions STAY INSIDE APPS. Redis only shares session and events. No broker infrastructure invented. Bottom note 'Redis는 새 단일 장애점이 된다. 구독 정보는 각 앱에 남는다.' Unambiguous arrows no crossing text, ample whitespace, large legible Korean. No success claims or metrics.
